he2024gretriever.title: G-Retriever: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Textual Graph Understanding and Question Answering
he2024gretriever.metadata_checks: Title, eight-author order, NeurIPS 2024, volume 37, pages 132876--132907, Curran Associates publisher, and DOI 10.52202/079017-4224 agree with official proceedings export. Author names checked against PDF title page. Editors omitted from addition to match existing bibliography style.
he2024gretriever.method_support: Section 4.3 describes PCST subgraph retrieval. Query similarity determines node/edge prizes, while edge cost controls subgraph size. Retrieved subgraph supplies graph QA. Do not claim this work cannot process cyclic graphs.

ma2025tog2.title: Think-on-Graph 2.0: Deep and Faithful Large Language Model Reasoning with Knowledge-guided Retrieval Augmented Generation
ma2025tog2.metadata_checks: Title, eight-author order, ICLR 2025, and pages 52782--52806 agree with official proceedings export. Full names and order checked against PDF first page. No DOI supplied on official page or BibTeX, so none fabricated. Export's redundant volume={2025} and editors omitted.
ma2025tog2.method_support: Sections 3.1--3.3 describe topic entity initialization, alternating KG relation/entity exploration and entity-linked text retrieval, contextual pruning, and retaining useful clues for iterative answering. It is training-free and uses externally supplied KG/text. Distinguish SA-MCGS by SCC-focused search and risk-endpoint-preserving output rather than claiming ToG-2 lacks evidence retention.
